title: Copper off, pepper aboard
body: Lin Wen has copper basins to sell before he takes pepper and tin aboard. The court's kitchens would use every basin. The market buyers are in no hurry to show him their coin, and he won't miss noon over it. “Buy what you will, Shahbandar, but have someone here to carry it.”

choices.label: Buy the full lot and pay for carriers now
choices.outcome_text: Lin Wen is paid the going price and your carriers clear the deck in time for his pepper and tin. The court kitchens take the lot; the market buyers get no basins.

choices.label: Buy half and let the market bid on the rest
choices.outcome_text: The state takes half at the going price. The market buyers get enough basins to make a bid worth their while, but Lin Wen has to wait while they count their money.

choices.label: Leave the sale to the market
choices.outcome_text: The treasury spends nothing. Lin Wen is still haggling as his pepper comes down to the quay and has to finish loading in a hurry.
